decision.question: Has the image been transformed into a coherent chalk drawing, with drawing-like forms and chalk rendering replacing substantial source-like photographic structure in both the subjects and background?
decision.criteria: Pass only when the main subjects and surrounding scene are rendered as a coherent chalk-made drawing, with drawing-like forms and chalk marks replacing substantial source-like photographic anatomy, patterns, and scene detail in both subjects and background. Fail if substantial photographic structure remains in either the subjects or background, even if chalk rendering is visible. Unknown if the source or edited image is unavailable or evidence is insufficient.
decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Assess subjects and background separately. Keep the completion threshold strict: residual substantial photographic structure in either means the requested transformation is incomplete. Do not infer completion from texture, scene-wide coverage, or recognizable chalk effects alone. Judge the requested chalk-medium transformation, not a particular style.
